channel.title: Paksh: Society
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Americans Stock Up Amidst Wave of Outages
item.description: Americans are preparing for potential doomsday scenarios by stocking up on food, water, and cash due to a wave of outages. The specific nature and cause of these outages are not detailed in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Pearl Harbor Survivor Gebhard Galle Dies at 105
item.description: Gebhard 'Geb' Galle, a survivor of the Pearl Harbor attack, has died at the age of 105. He was remembered for saving four shipmates during the attack. Another report states he was 106 years old. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Teachers in Ontario's elementary school system have overwhelmingly voted in favor of a strike mandate, making them the third union in the province to do so. The Ontario Public School Teachers' Federation (OPSTF) announced the results of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Haitians Rally in Support of El Salvador's Anti-Gang Deployment
item.description: In Haiti, a group of citizens held a demonstration to express support for the deployment of El Salvadoran troops to combat gangs. The protest occurred amidst ongoing gang violence in Haiti, which has destabilized the country. El Salvador's… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Florence Pugh Responds to Plastic Surgery Rumors
item.description: Actress Florence Pugh has expressed frustration over rumors suggesting she has undergone plastic surgery. She described the claims as "disturbing" and stated she was losing patience with them. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Islam projected to become world's largest religion by 2035
item.description: Islam is projected to become the world's largest religion by 2035, with the Hindu share of the global population expected to decline. By the same year, Muslims are also projected to outnumber Christians globally. These demographic shifts… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.description: The highly anticipated video game Grand Theft Auto VI has been released, 13 years after its predecessor, drawing significant global attention. Reviews have largely been positive, with some describing it as a 'masterpiece' and noting a… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 8 · Right 2.

item.title: Rain causes ceiling leak at Microsoft conference, flooding Meta stall
item.description: Heavy rain in San Francisco caused a ceiling leak at the Microsoft Ignite conference, leading to disruptions and flooding the Meta stall. The incident was part of wider weather-related disruptions across the region. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) estimates that a survey of building safety in Delhi could take four years to complete, requiring approximately 500 staff. The audit is projected to require 4 million hours, equivalent to 500,000… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Six young actors poised to become Bollywood's next stars
item.description: On International Men's Day 2026, six young actors have been highlighted as potentially becoming the next big stars in Bollywood. Among those named are Ahaan Panday, Lakshya, and Babil Khan. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The timetable for the Karnataka 1st PUC (Pre-University Certificate) examinations in 2027 has been released. The schedule includes subject-wise timings for the February exams. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Shaina NC faced protests and demands for an FIR after she accidentally tore a photograph of Shiv Sena founder Bal Thackeray during a protest. The incident occurred during a Shiv Sena protest against a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: A Pew Research Center study projecting global religious demographics between 2020 and 2070 forecasts that the Muslim population will grow by 80% worldwide, while the Hindu population will grow by 17%. The study indicates that India's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 4.

item.title: PM Modi Lays Foundation Stone for Gurudwara Redevelopment in Manila
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the 124-year-old Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara in Manila, Philippines, and laid the foundation stone for its redevelopment. The Gurudwara is described as the oldest in the Philippines. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 3.

item.description: A proposal has been put forward to introduce a Vande Bharat Sleeper train service between Mumbai and Varanasi. This new service aims to significantly reduce travel time, from the current 25-30 hours to an estimated 16-18 hours. The demand… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi Approves ₹10 Lakh Annual Health Cover for Transgender Community
item.description: The Delhi government has approved an annual health cover of ₹10 lakh for transgender persons. This inclusion will be under the Ayushman Bharat scheme. The decision was made by the Delhi Cabinet. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Vishuddhi Sena deployed to clean pilgrimage sites
item.description: A 1,000-member group called the Vishuddhi Sena has been deployed to maintain cleanliness at Sabarimala and other pilgrimage centers during the Mandalam season. The Sena's efforts are focused on keeping these sites clean. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: The remains of six United States soldiers who died during the Korean War have been identified seven decades after their deaths. Among the identified soldiers were two teenagers. The identification process took place decades after the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Mario Vargas Llosa's Life Explored in New Biography
item.description: A new biography by Gerald Martin delves into the multifaceted life of Mario Vargas Llosa. The book explores the various aspects and experiences that have shaped the renowned author. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: BBC Series 'This City Is Ours' Viewers Demand Action After Finale
item.description: Following the conclusion of the BBC series 'This City Is Ours', viewers have expressed a unified demand, as reported by multiple outlets. The finale of the second season prompted discussions and explanations of its twists among the cast. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: A JetBlue flight en route to Florida experienced severe turbulence, leading to several people being checked for injuries upon landing at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL). Fire rescue services were present at the scene… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The European Union is advising citizens to prepare emergency kits that can sustain them for 72 hours. This initiative encourages individuals to gather essential supplies in anticipation of potential emergencies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Lawmakers Seek Probe After Diwali Event Disrupted by Activists
item.description: US lawmakers are demanding action following the disruption of a Diwali celebration by activists who promoted the 'replacement' theory. Indian-American lawmaker Pramila Jayapal has specifically requested a probe into the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: EuroKids Campaign Highlights Lessons Children Teach Adults
item.description: EuroKids has launched a campaign titled '#UnexpectedTeachers' which aims to celebrate the lessons that children teach adults. The campaign focuses on the reciprocal nature of learning within families and educational settings. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: J&K to reserve 25% private school seats for disadvantaged children
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir is set to implement a 25% reservation for economically weaker sections (EWS) and disadvantaged children in private schools. The rules are in the final stage of notification and are expected to be issued shortly. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Apple Maps has introduced significant updates for users in India, including the addition of over 300 3D landmarks. The new features also bring 'Look Around' functionality and augmented reality (AR) navigation to the Indian market, offering… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Actress Anne Hathaway has welcomed her third child with husband Adam Shulman. The Oscar-winning actress's third child was welcomed with her husband Adam Shulman. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Mere Krishn Performance Series Reaches 101 Shows, Plans More
item.description: The performance series 'Mere Krishn' has completed 101 shows within eight months and is planning over 100 additional performances across India. The series is continuing its run with further shows scheduled. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
